value: Exploration game inspired by Shrink EXP (Shrink%20EXP%2027a704c4333f81038cb4ff6d2d2e1106.md) with a bunch of different vore scenarios with stamina escape minigames, using Daz3D renders

You play as Paige, a “doll” who has lost all her memories. The women of this world seem to have a visceral physical attraction which causes them to use you as a toy when they catch you. Explore the world to uncover the truth about how you ended up in your current state.
